prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. One standalone Blue Hermit grapple product image for image-to-3D. The input is the approved Blue grapple dock sheet. Use only the brass spool, short blue ribbon lead and broad bronze crescent hook shown in the LOWER row. Isolate those parts into one compact connected accessory. Remove the forearm, leather bracer and its snap strap, cuff, dock socket, hand, all captions, dividers and background. The mount on the forearm is a separate asset.
On a plain uniform white background, show one small antique bronze sewing-ribbon spool on the LEFT with broad circular flat brass flange, dark bronze beveled rim, a simple round flat indigo enamel center, and a thick visible winding of flat woven deep-blue silk ribbon between two brass flanges. One short straight broad indigo ribbon lead exits the side of the spool and runs horizontally to the simple bronze eye at the back of the RIGHT hook. One compact broad C-shaped bronze crescent anchor, two smooth rounded tapering horns facing RIGHT, open negative space between them, short center shank aligned to the ribbon, no third point. Its crescent height roughly matches spool diameter. Clear slight gap between spool and hook, only ribbon connects them. Any small fitting underneath spool is only one compact keyed bronze lug. No loose ribbon tails or redundant metal rings. Keep the reel and crescent geometry clean and readable, matching approved design.
FRONT view: slightly elevated orthographic view of broad faces of reel and crescent, very shallow tilt so visible thickness and coiled ribbon along near rim of spool, horizontal center axis, both shapes legible. Complete silhouette centered in square canvas, wide margins all around. Soft neutral lighting, subdued non-mirror aged bronze, clean believable textures, style of supplied illustration. No body, no glove, no strap, no multiple views, no text, no swatches, no cast shadow, no pedestal or watermark. One isolated connected grapple only.

Use case: identity-preserve object turnaround. Input is the exact Blue Hermit grapple to match in one additional clean image-to-3D angle. Rotate the SAME object around its long horizontal left-right axis; preserve its length, scale and component proportions, with spool always on image LEFT and hook always on image RIGHT. One antique bronze spool with broad circular flanges and flat indigo face disk only on its front, thick winding of dark blue flat silk between flanges, small mounting lug centered underneath its plain reverse face. One single short taut blue flat ribbon connects spool to the ONE bronze swivel eye on the short straight shank of one thick C-shaped bronze crescent hook, two horns facing right, no third point. Use original aged bronze, indigo textile and softened finish, same white backdrop and neutral lighting. Do not add clasps, extra knobs, another reel, loops, bracer, weapons, parts, labels, text, perspective distortions, or shadows. Single whole object at centered original horizontal scale, fully inside square canvas. Exactly one view per image.
BACK / UNDERSIDE view. Turn the grapple over 180 degrees about the horizontal left-right axis, showing the back face with a shallow orthographic tilt to reveal thickness. Spool left, crescent right. The formerly visible blue enamel disk is on the far face and hidden; the near face now is a simple flat brass underside with only a small centered rectangular bronze mounting lug. Ribbon windings still visible between rims and only one short ribbon lead to the same eye. Show opposite broad face of the same crescent without changing its two-horn silhouette, thickness or scale.

Use case: identity-preserve object turnaround. Input is the exact Blue Hermit grapple to match in one additional clean image-to-3D angle. Rotate the SAME object around its long horizontal left-right axis; preserve its length, scale and component proportions, with spool always on image LEFT and hook always on image RIGHT. One antique bronze spool with broad circular flanges and flat indigo face disk only on its front, thick winding of dark blue flat silk between flanges, small mounting lug centered underneath its plain reverse face. One single short taut blue flat ribbon connects spool to the ONE bronze swivel eye on the short straight shank of one thick C-shaped bronze crescent hook, two horns facing right, no third point. Use original aged bronze, indigo textile and softened finish, same white backdrop and neutral lighting. Do not add clasps, extra knobs, another reel, loops, bracer, weapons, parts, labels, text, perspective distortions, or shadows. Single whole object at centered original horizontal scale, fully inside square canvas. Exactly one view per image.
UPPER EDGE profile. Rotate around the horizontal long axis to look from above the upper edge of the object across its depth, about 80 degrees away from the broad face view. The object is still long left-to-right. Broad round spool flanges should appear as thin foreshortened elongated ellipses over the same thick indigo winding, compact axis height, partial narrow glint of original blue disk. The same two-pronged crescent should be strongly foreshortened into a low side profile, with a little separation of the two thick bronze tips visible. The ribbon stays a very short straight flat bridge into the original eye. Preserve length relationships of all parts. No end-on view and no straight-on repetition.
